reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001135 (the melody read from 001135a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Johann Cruger's dates (1598–1662) are from our page for the tune AUF, AUF, MEIN HERZ MIT FREUDEN (content/hymns/tunes/auf-auf-mein-herz-mit-freuden.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1653.
